stage: Healing renderer acceptance passed. Managed integration, final package and publication remain pending.

nativeSource.qualification: Retained renderer was built during M41. Its complete game source and compiled SDK runtime are byte-identical to published v0.36, while package metadata predates publication. Healing/refill/proc-heal operations are still native in this control.

procs.comparison: Retained native cue harness plus one earned low-life ward course. Proc grant, low-life setup and a temporary zero RNG are explicit. Original eight cue stages remain; those stages partly call native executeProc directly. New ward course calls World.update, observes the public own-event hook and checks the visible ward count. No device or physical-input claim. Expected observations come from two retained published-v0.32 renderer executions; the catalogue separately matches a fresh pinned-original probe. No candidate output produces these expected results.

visualReview.findings: Mend displays a green +66 with life 566; seal clipping displays +10 and life 510; native and SDK gain screenshots show matching green bead glyphs with life 526. The native gold seal label overlaps the life number at this position; existing presentation is preserved. Review covers sampled screenshots and the recorded canvas calls, not portable pixel identity.

scope: Native Mend and Greater Mending via the real skill-input/frame path, life-orb drawing and floating heal text, a controlled life seal, host refill, regeneration under normal/paused/slowed world clocks, and native Guarded Heart selection/execution from a controlled block event with gain/expiry/full-life HUD drawing. Records actual canvas calls and screenshots. The block event and refill are host inputs, not physical combat or device-input evidence. No pixel-equivalence, renderer-FPS or physical-device claim.
